extensionDescription.message: Save current-window tabs as Markdown, text, or JSON, and reopen them by dropping a file.

importIntro.message: Add tabs from a file. Your existing tabs stay open.

dropOne.message: Drop one file to get started.

importHelp.message: Supports files exported by this extension. Duplicate URLs open separately; JSON restores pinned tabs. Unsupported addresses, such as internal settings pages, are skipped.

closeWarning.message: Private windows are excluded. Saving may not finish when Firefox exits.

saveDirect.message: Skip the save dialog for manual exports

folderHelp.message: Leave blank to use your default Downloads folder. To use another drive, change the download folder in Firefox settings. Auto-save skips the dialog and creates a new timestamped file.

cannotReadTabs.message: Could not read this window’s tabs.

unsupportedFile.message: Drop an MD, TXT, or JSON file.

oneFileOnly.message: Please drop one file at a time.

dropAnother.message: Drop another file to import more tabs.

invalidFolder.message: Use a relative folder, such as Firefox Tabs/Backup.

missingTabs.message: The JSON must contain a tabs array.

noTabs.message: There are no tabs to export.

importBusy.message: An import is already running in this window.

unsupportedUrl.message: The file contains an unsupported address.
